services.name: WWI Exhibit
services.desc: This exhibit commemorated the 150th anniversary of the American Civil War. It included items belonging to Lt. Howard Mather Burnham who died at the battle of Chickamauga, photos of two Coomes brothers killed in the war, and many other artifacts from the era. This exhibit was the first to be launched in the newly renovated exhibit room. The room was painted and had motion-activated LED lights installed. The exhibit was launched in 2016 and was scheduled to coincide with the 300th anniversary of Williams' ordination as minister of First Church. services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: Take a guided tour through the Longmeadow Cemetery with a Longmeadow Historical Society board member. Tours available on Friday 10/17 at 4:30PM and Saturday 10/18 at 10:30AM. Take a guided tour through the Longmeadow Cemetery with a Longmeadow Historical Society board member who will discuss the history of the burying ground and illustrate the art of the gravestones; explain symbolism on the gravestones; discuss some of the known gravestone carvers; point out some of the town’s revolutionary soldiers; and identify causes of death.
